layout_structure.sidebar_nav: w-64 border-r border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 flex flex-col justify-between hidden md:flex

evidence_package_viewer.layout: Side-by-side split screen + Timeline + Inspector Tabs
components: Synchronized Video Player Controls (Play/Pause together, scrubber link, frame stepper)
Timeline scrubbing bar highlighting matched clip ranges (Protected vs Candidate)
Representative Frame Extraction Strip with micro-diff overlay
Audio Alignment Waveform & Fingerprint spectrum viewer
Multi-Metric Score Radar/Breakdown (Confidence 94%, Visual Sim 91%, Audio 88%, Structural 96%) - MUST state: 'Algorithmic indicators only; human review required'
Reason Codes & Transformation Notes (e.g., Speed shift 1.1x, Crop 15%, Pitch shifted)
Rights Metadata Panel (Flags 'rights verification needed' when license or territorial rights are missing)
Conflicting Signals Banner (e.g., High visual match vs Low audio match signal alert)

human_review_decision_panel.role_enforcement_lock: Show disabled state with tooltip 'Approver role required for enforcement execution' when user is in Reviewer mode

features: Real-Time Fingerprint & Vector Embedding Generation Progress Bar

component_guidelines.shadcn_usage: Use customized Shadcn primitives (Table, Tabs, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Badge, Select, Tooltip, Sheet, Progress, Accordion, Alert, Slider)
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner library for action feedback (e.g. 'Decision recorded: Case #CS-9402 Actioned as Takedown')
component_guidelines.charts: Recharts radar and sync area charts styled with amber/gold (#E5A93C), slate gray (#475569), and alert red (#EF4444)

hero_and_cinematic_imagery.description: Vibrant neon film theater sign glowing at nighttime
hero_and_cinematic_imagery.usage: Login page background overlay and case header thumbnail

hero_and_cinematic_imagery.description: Cameraman silhouette captures event in dimly lit theater ambiance
hero_and_cinematic_imagery.usage: Protected asset registration placeholder and empty states

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, mandatory on all buttons, inputs, tables, badges, tabs, and decision triggers
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: WCAG AA / APCA compliant high-contrast dark palette (slate-950 background with slate-100 text)
accessibility_and_testing.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect system settings by disabling frame animations

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, dense, high-performance operational analyst console for CineShield 2.0.
Set dark mode as default with sleek dark slate background (#090C10) and amber gold accent (#E5A93C).
The landing page MUST be the Review Queue with dense data rows, priority scores, sorting, filtering, saved views, and duplicate grouping.

Case detail view MUST include side-by-side synchronized video simulation, timeline matched segments, score breakdown radar, rights metadata with 'rights verification needed' status, conflicting signals alert, and decision panel.
Enforce required rationale on decisions and display role switcher (Analyst, Legal Approver, Admin) to showcase role-based enforcement locking.
Add complete data-testid attributes to all key interactions.
